factors.label: Small team can prototype it in weeks

options.label: Epistemic NPCs: rumours spread with provenance chains and trust; hearsay never justifies irreversible acts
Evidence thresholds scale with action irreversibility; uncertain NPCs probe (ask, check) before acting
Behaviour diffs: replay recorded sessions against a changed config/model and show which decisions changed and why
Proof-carrying actions: any third-party AI runtime submits actions with a certificate the engine checks cheaply
Commitments as contracts: NPC and player promises tracked as obligations verified against engine state
World-consistent cast: no two NPCs ever assert contradictory facts about authoritative state

runs.ask: DECISION: What is the next real innovation for this layer: a new mechanism (not a feature) that no competitor implements, that makes AI NPCs feel alive while staying safe to ship?

paths.label: Partner with one indie studio for closed beta
paths.description: Embed with a small studio to co-design the reliability layer against their specific gameplay loops. Their feedback validates the mechanism before scaling.

paths.label: Release open-source invariant test suite
paths.description: Publish the property-based invariant tests as a standalone tool. Studios adopt the tests first, creating demand for the middleware that passes them.
paths.check: Publish the test suite on GitHub; measure if 3+ external studios fork or reference it within 14 days.
